TYTAN TechnologiesThe PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We thrive, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who thrive on ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in.At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect Europe’s sovereignty.Scaling this mission takes a People function that's just as rigorous, clear and compliant, precision isn't optional it is the standard and this extends to how we build and support our team. As People Operations Specialist, you'll be a hands-on part of that foundation, owning first-tier employee support while growing into broader People Operations responsibilities.Your roadmap to make an impact- Employee support & documentation: Be the first point of contact for employee inquiries and own HR-related documentation, including Arbeitsbescheinigungen, EZB, Zeugnisse, and other employee documents.- Benefits & HR administration: Handle employee questions around benefits and support the day-to-day administration of benefits and other HR processes.- Employment contracts: Support employment contract processes, including preparing new contracts, amendments, and related documentation.- Payroll: Support payroll-related processes and data, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely execution.- Keep employee data accurate and up to date: Maintain personnel master data and documentation with a high level of precision and confidentiality.- Take on different responsibilities: Get involved across HR Operations and take ownership of new topics as they arise, constantly getting involved in different areas, figuring things out, and getting things done.- Learn and grow: Build experience across the employee lifecycle and take on increasing responsibility as you develop.Job requirements- 1–2 years of experience in HR, People Operations, or a similar role.- Ownership & initiative: You take responsibility, follow things through, and proactively solve problems rather than waiting to be told what to do.- Fast learner & hands-on mindset: You pick up new topics quickly, enjoy figuring things out, and are happy to jump into different areas and take on new responsibilities.- Reliable & detail-oriented: You’re highly organized and precise, especially when working with employee data, contracts, payroll, and other sensitive information.- Strong communication skills: You’re approachable, responsive, and comfortable working in a fast paced international environment- Fluent German and strong English, both written and spoken are required.Why TYTAN?- Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defence systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security- Shape scalable defence capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale- Contribute to networked air defence: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defence architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors- Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback- Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact- Define a new generation of defence technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company- Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for EuropeOur Benefits- Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through Virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation- Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit- Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us- Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team- Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together- Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands- Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaborationAbout usAt TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.

Was Sie erwartetMöchtest du dazu beitragen, den weltweiten Übergang zur nachhaltigen Energie zu beschleunigen?  Bei Tesla ist das unsere Mission! Wir suchen talentierte Kfz-Technikerinnen für Teslas Service Center in ganz Deutschland. Bei Tesla sind unsere Mechanikerinnen das Rückgrat des Servicebetriebs und unterstützen unsere Mission, den weltweiten Übergang zu nachhaltiger Energie zu beschleunigen. Wir haben eines der innovativsten Fahrzeuge aller Zeiten entwickelt, und als Servicetechniker*in trägst du dazu bei, unserer Kundschaft einen ebenso innovativen Service zu bieten. Wir bieten:- Karriereentwicklung und Weiterbildung: Bei Tesla hast du die Möglichkeit zur persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung durch regelmäßige Performance Reviews, gezielte Trainingsmaßnahmen und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten (z.B. Hochvoltschulungen, Managementtrainings)- Unternehmenskultur: Tauche ein in unsere inspirierende Unternehmenskultur, in der Innovation, Teamwork und Leidenschaft im Mittelpunkt stehen- Innovative Projekte und Technologien: Du hast die Chance, an wegweisenden Projekten und Technologien zu arbeiten, die die Zukunft der Automobilindustrie und nachhaltiger Energie mitgestalten- Vorteile und Zusatzleistungen: Dich erwartet ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalts- und Leistungspaket, das neben Tesla Aktien oder einem CashAward auch den Zugang zu unserem Corporate Benefits Programm, 30 Tage Urlaub, ein 13. Monatsgehalt sowie die Option auf eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge und einen Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket umfasst - Engagiertes Team und positive Arbeitsatmosphäre: Arbeite in einem engagierten und motivierten Team, das sich durch eine tolle Stimmung und hervorragende Teamarbeit auszeichnet. Sei Teil eines Teams, das einen Beitrag zur nachhaltigen Zukunft und zu erneuerbaren Energien leistet  Was zu tun ist- Service, Reparatur und Verbesserung: Mit Tesla-spezifischer Software und fortschrittlichen Tools führst du Reparaturen und Wartungen an allen Arten von Tesla-Fahrzeugen durch  - Qualitätssicherstellung: Wir vertrauen darauf, dass du unsere Fahrzeuge vor der Rückgabe und Vorablieferung sorgfältig prüfst und mit dem höchsten Qualitätsstandards arbeitest - Zusammenarbeit: Wenn du teamübergreifend (lokal und regional) arbeitest, tausche dich aus und Teile deine Erfahrung, um das Serviceerlebnis weiter zu verbessern - Entwicklung: Bereite dich auf den Erfolg vor. Unsere engagierten internen Schulungsteams schulen dich in Tesla-spezifischer Technologie und der Reparatur von Elektrofahrzeugen Was mitzubringen ist- Technische Erfahrung: Du verfügst über Berufserfahrung in der Durchführung von Fahrzeugservice und Reparaturarbeiten in der Automobil-, Luftfahrt-, Marine- oder ähnlichen Industrien - Technische Qualifizierung: Du verfügst über eine entsprechende Zertifizierung, um in Deutschland Fahrzeugreparaturen durchführen zu können (Ausbildung zum Mechatroniker*in) - Verantwortlichkeit: Du übernimmst eine Vorreiterrolle bei Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsbedenken, die während der Arbeit auftreten - Kommunikationsfähigkeit: Du sprichst und schreibst gut Deutsch und weißt, wie du deinen Standpunkt klar und respektvoll vermitteln kannst - Teamfähigkeit und Flexibilität: Du arbeitest gerne eng mit verschiedenen Menschen zusammen und kannst gute Arbeitsbeziehungen zu allen internen Interessengruppen aufbauen und pflegen. jobs.description: The German Institute of Human Nutrition Potsdam-Rehbruecke (DIfE) (https://www.dife.de/en/) is a member of the Leibniz Association. The institute’s mission is to conduct experimental and clinical research in the field of nutrition and health, with the aim of understanding the molecular basis of nutrition-dependent diseases, and of developing new strategies for treatment and prevention.The Junior Research Group of Gut-Brain Interactions (GBI) (https://www.dife.de/en/research/departments-and-labs/gut-brain-interactions/)  invites applications for1 Postdoc (m/f/d)starting May 1, 2027.Project descriptionThe project investigates how signals from the stomach interact with brain systems supporting arousal, attention and cognition. Combining electrogastrography (EGG) with EEG, fMRI and peripheral physiology, we study the neural dynamics of stomach–brain coupling in healthy individuals. A central aim is to determine whether experimentally induced changes in arousal influence gastric–brain coupling independently of changes in gastric activity, and how these dynamics relate to vigilance and behaviour. PhD Position (E13, 65%) in Tumor ImmunologyThe Chair for Infection Pathogenesis is looking for academic staff, starting as soon as possible.BackgroundWe are seeking a highly motivated PhD candidate (E13, 65%) to join a DFG-funded research project investigating the role of tumor-associated neutrophils (TANs) in intestinal polyp dynamics in a pig model. The pig model provides an excellent opportunity to explore the diverse facets of comparative immunology and to bridge fundamental immunological mechanisms with translational research.This project aims to elucidate the function of TANs on polyp growth and regression with a particular focus on their interaction with the local tissue microenvironment and immune response. A key component of the project will be the establishment and use of intestinal organoid–neutrophil co-culture models to study TAN-mediated effects on epithelial and polyp cells. The successful candidate will work in an interdisciplinary research environment using state-of-the-art molecular, cellular, immunological, and organoid-based approaches.Your responsibilitiesThe successful candidate will plan and conduct experimental studies investigating TAN phenotypes and functions during intestinal polyp development. The work combines in vivo studies using transgenic animal models, including animal breeding, sample collection, and histopathological analyses, with in vitro organoid–immune cell co-culture systems and molecular, cellular and immunological assays. The candidate will analyse and interpret the resulting data, present findings at scientific meetings, and contribute to manuscripts and reports. Independent experimental work, careful sample handling, and a high level of scientific responsibility are expected.Your qualifications, key skills and experience- Master’s degree or Staatsexamen or equivalent in Veterinary Medicine, Animal sciences, Medicine, Biology, Biotechnology or related fields- Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in an international team- Strong interest in tumour immunology, inflammation, and gastrointestinal disease- Experience with molecular biology, flow cytometry, immunohistochemistry, cell culture, or animal models is advantageous- Very good written and spoken English, Strong analysis and problem-solving capacitiesWhat we offerThe candidate will have the opportunity to work in an interdisciplinary and international scientific environment. Research staff is supported by easy access to scientific expertise, well-equipped lab and core facilities and an active science community @Weihenstephan Campus. We offer a three-year PhD position funded by the German Research Foundation (DFG) and an employment according to TV-L E13 (65%).Your applicationIf you are interested in working in our team, please send your application by mail together with a strong CV and supporting documentation to the Chair of Infection Pathogenesis* (friederike.ebner@tum.de)*.Technische Universität MünchenSchool of Life Sciences – Infection PathogenesisProf. Dr. rer. nat.
